# Transfer Split Airport

> Private airport transfers and taxi service from Split Airport (SPU) to destinations across the Dalmatian coast, Croatia. Fixed prices, professional drivers, 24/7 availability.

Transfer Split Airport provides private, fixed-price vehicle transfers between Split Airport and Split, Kaštela, Trogir, Podstrana, Omiš, Primošten, Makarska, Brela, Baška Voda, Šibenik, Vodice, Zadar, Plitvice Lakes, and Dubrovnik. Vehicles: sedan (up to 4 passengers), business van (up to 7 passengers), and van (up to 8 passengers). Online booking with instant fixed pricing, WhatsApp contact, and Netlify Forms-based reservation.

## Key pages

- [Homepage & Booking](/): Book a transfer with live address autocomplete and instant fixed pricing
- [Fleet](/fleet): Vehicle classes, capacity and pricing
- [Services](/services): Full list of transfer services offered
- [All Destinations](/destinations): Every route served with fixed one-way prices
- [Blog](/blog/): Travel guides for Split Airport transfers and the Dalmatian coast
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, and email contact details

## Fixed one-way pricing from Split Airport

- Split / Kaštela / Trogir: €40
- Podstrana: €45
- Omiš: €55
- Primošten: €65
- Makarska: €75
- Brela: €80
- Baška Voda: €80
- Šibenik: €85
- Vodice: €95
- Zadar: €150
- Plitvice Lakes: €180
- Dubrovnik: €240

Return trips are billed as two one-way transfers (no round-trip discount).
